Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Stored securely and used for Reson8 transcription. Validate to load Reson8's models and your custom models.
Settings.CustomModelsLoaded: {0} custom model(s) loaded. Validate to refresh.
Settings.NoCustomModels: No custom models yet. Validate to fetch any custom models.
Settings.CustomBaseUrlDescription: Advanced: for a LiveKit gateway or custom proxy. Leave blank for the default.
Settings.CustomAuthHeaderDescription: Advanced: header name used to send the API key. Leave blank for the default.
Settings.ApiKeyValidWithModels: API key valid. {0} custom model(s) loaded.
Settings.NotConfiguredApiKeyRequired: Plugin not configured. API key required.
Settings.InvalidApiKeyCharacters: The API key contains a line break or another control character.
Settings.InvalidBaseUrl: Enter an absolute http:// or https:// base URL without credentials, query or fragment.
Settings.InvalidAuthHeader: Enter a valid HTTP header name as the custom auth header.
Settings.ServerUnreachable: Couldn't reach the Reson8 server. Check your connection and the base URL.
Settings.ServerRedirected: The Reson8 server redirected the request. Enter the final address as the base URL.
Settings.CustomModelsRefreshFailed: API key valid, but the model lists couldn't be refreshed ({0}). Previously loaded models are kept.
Settings.SettingsChangedDuringValidation: The settings changed during validation. Validate again.
Settings.SelectedModelUnavailable: The selected Reson8 model isn't loaded for this API key and server. Validate to refresh the models, or choose the default model.
Settings.ModelDoesNotStream: The selected Reson8 model transcribes recordings only, not live audio.
Settings.FillerModeDescription: Natural leaves it to the model, so filler words such as “um” may appear in some places and not others. Clean leaves them out, which suits dictation. Verbatim keeps them as spoken. Rumble-2-Flash ignores this setting.
Settings.BiasStrengthDescription: How strongly dictionary terms and custom models steer recognition. Higher values catch these terms more often, but can also turn similar-sounding words into them. Default: {0}.
Manifest.Name: Reson8
Manifest.Description: Cloud transcription via Reson8 speech-to-text API with real-time WebSocket streaming. Requires API key.
